name: Whispering Meadows
description: Gentle grasslands bathed in soft light where luminescent flora sways in the tranquil breeze.

name: Sunlit Steppe
description: Vast, open plains marked by low earthen rolls and scattered ancient monoliths.

name: Shimmering Marshes
description: A serene wetland filled with shallow pools and mild hummocks that glow under the moonlight.

name: Autumnal Foothills
description: Rolling golden hills adorned with vibrant amber forests and mild stone bluffs.

name: Crystal Highlands
description: Rugged elevated plateaus laced with towering quartz formations and steep grassy mounds.

name: Obsidian Ridge
description: Craggy volcanic hills with sharp slopes and dark basalt terraces rising above ash-filled valleys.

name: Frostfire Peaks
description: Towering glaciated mountains pierced by glowing geothermal vents and treacherous slopes.

name: Shattered Spires
description: An extreme landscape of sheer vertical pinnacles floating above abyssal chasms.
